set.body: Define the contract before representation migration. Specify logical grid access as (i,j,k) and (i,j,k,t), with z meaning the third grid-axis slice and affine geometry defining world or anatomical orientation. Specify rank, shape, channel or component axes, time axes, slicing, mutability, aliasing, ownership, layout, and error semantics. Reconcile the current ScalaFIM first-axis-fastest convention with Ravel physical layout without exposing raw offsets. Build a matched evidence court covering public dense image workloads, layout parity, checksums, aliasing, allocations, JVM and Scala.js behavior, and visible losses. Acceptance: the contract is executable; legacy and target semantics are compared on identical workloads; no migration proceeds on an implicit transpose or unmeasured wrapper cost.
set.title: Freeze image indexing, layout, and performance contracts
